answer: A farm cannot present clean aliases since the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Histories are stored in lantern, checked in comet, and jade shows each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 19 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 3576 identities would post 4237 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
